_comment: Economy curves & targets. The simulator (tools/studio/run-sim.ts) asserts the `targets` block; balance changes must keep them green.

reward._note: coins = value * satisfaction * (1 + perfectTipBonus*[perfect] + speedBonus) * comboMult * tipMult * eventMult * (1 + (customerTipMultiplier - 1) * customerTipWeight). Customer generosity scales a damped tip term, never the whole plate price, so a VIP cannot swing a turn by 6x. Verified by tools/studio/run-sim.ts (coinSpike target).
reward._curvesNote: levelUpCoins(level) = round(base * level^exponent). A geometric curve here was measured to pay 10.3M coins at level 47 (see docs/06-ECONOMY.md "exponential blow-up"); polynomial keeps level rewards in the same order of magnitude as turn income.

idle._comment: Moeda offline por minuto por índice de restaurante (0 no quintal: sem idle antes do primeiro upgrade de fila). Regra que a curva obedece desde a escada de 10 telas: uma noite de 8 h com o `gerente` no máximo rende no máximo 1,75 dia da renda ativa daquele andar — conferido em tools/studio/test/economy.test.ts. Os índices 0-4 são a curva antiga medida (0/6/16/42/96) e já cabiam na regra. O índice 5 estava em 1,79 e os índices 6-9 seguiam dobrando (430/860/1 720/3 440) porque a extensão da escada herdou a razão antiga da tabela de 7 valores — e a renda ativa é horizontal por design depois do L30 (ver `_incomePlateauNote`), então dobrar o offline não dá progressão ao jogador, dá número maior na tela. Medido antes do corte: uma noite no `cozinha_do_campeao` pagava 17,08 dias de renda ativa (29,37 com o gerente no topo), ou seja, o jogo ótimo era dormir; agora 1,69. O XP tinha o buraco ao contrário: a tabela parava no índice 6 e cais/orla/campeão recebiam moeda e zero XP por noite, porque o `?? 0` da leitura engolia a linha que não existia em silêncio — as três telas novas valem 17/18/19 xp por minuto.

targets._comment: Balance guardrails. `npm run sim` (with LONG_HORIZON for multi-month pacing) fails the build if any target is violated. Bands were derived from the measured simulation on 2026-09-17 and are ~+-20% wide so they catch regressions without being a rubber stamp. Full derivation and the two exponential blow-ups this caught: docs/06-ECONOMY.md.
targets._pacingNote: Measured pacing 2026-09-25 after wiring the owned grill into the sim (economy v12): espetinho_rua 32 (day ~3), trailer 89 (day 7), bairro 147 (day 12), premium 243 (day 20), festival 418 (day 35), rede_nacional 1185 (day 99), assuming 12 turns/day. Grill path: ze_da_esquina 7, parrilla 45, fornalha 90. Restaurant bands were kept: adding the 51k grill sink did not move establishment pacing outside +-20%. The 418->1185 gap is filled by the collection (37), achievements (58), prestige tracks, the region route, weekly events and the Brasa Pass rather than by a new restaurant.
targets._grillPacingNote: The harness used to play every turn on the restaurant default 3-zone grill. Players start on 1-zone lata_valente and buy along 1F->2F->3F->Fornalha (must max current evo before the next unlock, same as the prototype Home CTA). First measurement with the old heatBase+0.85 ramp: fornalha peaked at 2.47 heat, campaign burn 20.3%, lost 11.4%, L15/L30 income 20% below band. Heat is now the default zone profile * heatBase, capped at 1.70. Re-measured: burn 5.7%, lost 6.9%, all restaurant/income targets still inside the existing bands.
targets._spendRatioNote: The harness is a deliberately greedy spender, so a ratio near 1.0 is the desired outcome (no coin accumulation). The LOWER bound is the real guardrail: it catches sinks that are too cheap or income that is too high, i.e. inflation.
targets._incomePlateauNote: L30 and L50 income are deliberately close (measured 95.4k vs 96.7k at skill 0.55). Level difficulty is capped at d=1.0, so after level 30 income is stable and progression becomes horizontal: restaurants, collection, prestige tracks and cosmetics rather than raw coin income. Pushing coin income past L30 would only put bigger numbers on screen without adding decisions.
targets._bandDerivationNote: Bands are +-20% around the measured curve above; they are regression guards, not aspirational targets. Raising restaurant coin costs alone does NOT slow pacing: the greedy harness spends the coins it cannot sink into a pricier restaurant on upgrades instead, raising income (sink substitution). Measured: raising bairro 12k->15k moved its unlock from turn 185 to 146, i.e. faster. Slow pacing by reducing income or by scaling ALL sinks together, never one sink alone.

_ladderNote: Bandas de destravamento das 10 churrasqueiras, em turnos, medidas na simulação longa (LONG_HORIZON=1500, `npm run sim:long`) depois do redesenho da escada: 3 / 7 / 19 / 50 / 61 / 95 / 184 / 309 / 509 para as nove compras depois da grelha inicial. Antes havia três compras (7 / 45 / 90) e o resto do jogo sem nada de grelha para almejar. As janelas são largas de propósito: o portão do topo é o nível (26 / 36 / 46) e a tela, não a moeda — a escada inteira de grelhas custa 1,39 milhão, 9,7% dos 14,4 milhões ganhos no run.
